interpretation: D2 is less damaging than C2 in this paired run, not a positive utility result. B2 without any auxiliary loss already loses AP in all four dev sources; C2 and D2 add further net damage. Data/implementation/deployment success does not establish a useful prototype mechanism.
stop: no extension or retuning of these three configurations
no prototype-slot/loss search to rescue this result
positive_research_focus: Separate Mask-branch weight adaptation from mixed-domain BN running-statistic adaptation, and establish a native adaptation baseline that preserves existing segmentation successes before revisiting auxiliary prototypes.
support_for_focus: B2 has no prototype/continuous auxiliary loss yet loses 1.121401492 AP vs N and damages 60/2126 native Mask75 successes.
All four prespecified dev source groups have negative B2-minus-N AP.

The native Mask branches train their dedicated BN with 2 real plus 6 synthetic RGB per update while shared/detection state stays exact; both learned Mask parameters and mixed-domain running statistics are credible competing pathways.
C2 and D2 do not repair this common baseline deficit; increasing auxiliary complexity has no current net-utility support.
unique_next_step: Freeze a new zero-training N/B2 2x2 weight-versus-Mask-BN-running-buffer exchange protocol using existing endpoints. Reuse the existing N/N and B2/B2 outputs; only two hybrid outputs would need evaluation under unchanged output identity and official metrics. This is a proposed next study, not part of the completed workflow and not launched.

next_step_predictions.BN_statistics_explanation: Restoring N running mean/variance to B2 weights should recover utility/retention, while transferring B2 statistics to N weights should reproduce damage. This would prioritize BN-statistics isolation for a separately authorized adaptation study.
next_step_predictions.weight_update_explanation: B2 weights remain damaging under N running statistics, while N weights with B2 statistics do not reproduce the loss. This would prioritize native-function-preserving parameter updates rather than a BN-only fix.
next_step_predictions.interaction_or_insufficient_evidence: Neither simple pathway explains the factorial outcomes or no hybrid satisfies native retention; do not admit a BN-only remedy or more auxiliary training. Retain N and close this adaptation recipe.

confidence_scope: One paired seed and four repeatedly used dev sources; source-cluster intervals are descriptive, not independent confirmation.
